title: Step-manifest contract: 3 to 5 steps per tour with per-step anchor selector and per-step content voice slot
description: The blueprint contributes a step-manifest contract for a 3 to 5 step onboarding tour. Each step declares a step id, an anchor selector (CSS resolved at step-open time to place the tooltip against a live element in the DOM), a heading and a body slot the project fills with its own voice. The step runner walks the manifest in order and refuses to open a step whose anchor does not resolve to a visible element rather than rendering a floating tooltip. The blueprint contributes the WHAT (the manifest shape and the resolver contract), not the words.
rationale: Per visual round 4 spec (2026-09-06) section 5.5, REQ 1 of the onboarding-tour blueprint.
